title: Laid-Back Camp Season 3
synopsis:
Within the narrow walls of the Outdoor Activities Club room, the few but lively members carry on the camping spirit as they have fun with DIY club experiments. Exciting experiences such as these have brought Nadeshiko Kagamihara deep into the world of camping, making her want to once again go on a solo trip.

However, other plans come first, as Ayano Toki and Rin Shima invite Nadeshiko to camp near Ooi River. Eager to go on their first journey together, the girls set off to forge precious memories that will stick with their hearts for years to come.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

episodes.title: Where Should We Go Next?
episodes.synopsis: Rin thinks back to how her grandpa got her into camping. Meanwhile, the Outdoor Activities Club gets back together for the first time in a while. They build an alcohol stove and plan their next outing. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Mini Camping and Yard Camping
episodes.synopsis: The Outclub girls decide to make a day of camping in Ena's yard to cut Aki's hair and try out their new DIY alcohol stoves. Meanwhile, a new camper takes some smaller trips for herself and starts dreaming big. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: We're Off! Land of Suspension Bridges
episodes.synopsis: On their way to meet up with Nadeshiko for a three-girl camping trip, Rin and Ayano bike their way around Ikawa to see the area's impressive array of suspension bridges. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Hatanagi Attack! Death Road from Hell
episodes.synopsis: Rin and Ayano bike their way up treacherous mountain roads and cross terrifying swinging bridges to make it to the campsite. While she waits for them, Nadeshiko takes in the sights and manages to find a scare of her own... (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Campfires and Beef Feasts
episodes.synopsis: Nadeshiko takes it upon herself to prep the campsite, as well as a few treats. When the other girls finally make it, it's time for a campfire and a camp-worthy feast! (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: See You Again Someday
episodes.synopsis: The three-girl camping trip is winding down, but Rin, Ayano, and Nadeshiko are determined to see everything there is to see and eat everything there is to eat before it's over! (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: True or Embellished? Retrospective Camping
episodes.synopsis: After Nadeshiko returns from the Oigawa trip, the other Outclub girls recount for her (somewhat dubiously) a spontaneous bus-based camping trip they took while she, Rin, and Ayano were away. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Food Porn Begins!!
episodes.synopsis: The Outclub girls share the delicious second half of their (somewhat embellished) camp trip story with Nadeshiko. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Touring and Checking Out the Cherry Blossoms
Chikuwa, Trains, Chiaki's Solo Campin
episodes.synopsis: Ena takes Chikuwa for a springtime walk in the park, Nadeshiko manages to sneak some trains into her cherry blossom tour with her sister, and Chiaki tries her hand at solo camping with a savory twist. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Scenery from Way Back
episodes.synopsis: Chiaki comes to find out that her surprise encounter with Aoi ahead of their cherry blossom camp trip is thanks to a sudden (and speedy) gift. Meanwhile, Rin joins up with Nadeshiko and her sister to take in some nostalgic scenery. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: April 2nd: Cherry Blossom Camp Trip
episodes.synopsis: The entire gang finally gets together for their much-awaited cherry blossom camp trip, and there's plenty of good food and good memories to go around! (Source: Crunchyroll)
